rationale: This is an interventional randomized study with an explicit placebo-controlled first period. The record states that Group 1 receives either Treg infusions and IL-2 injections or saline/placebo infusions and placebo injections, while the second period is open-label with no placebo for all participants.

evidence.quote: This study is a randomized, placebo-controlled, phase 2a trial
The first period is a 6-month, randomized, placebo-controlled part of the study
monthly expanded Tregs administered intravenously (IV) OR placebo (saline) administered intravenously plus subcutaneous low-dose Interleukin-2 (IL-2) OR subcutaneous placebo (saline) injections
Participants will receive matching placebo or inactive intravenous (IV) infusions once per month. The participant will also take a matching inactive placebo injection three times per week.
